response.sql: WITH track_bpm AS (SELECT AlbumId, UnitPrice, CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / Milliseconds AS bpm FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL), album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM track_bpm GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS overall_bpm FROM track_bpm) SELECT album_stats.AlbumId, album_stats.avg_unit_price, album_stats.avg_bpm, album_stats.avg_bpm - overall_avg.overall_bpm AS difference FROM album_stats CROSS JOIN overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
